reviews.summary: 独立框架评审：以「只读资料 + AI 助手」为例检验 NocoBase3 的 AI 员工、授权、应用装配与 DB 四个能力单元。总体判断是框架能力强、指引密集：授权组合、typed Repository 路由、ServiceProvider 装配、migration/seed 与 URL 可寻址浮层均由公开 API 与详尽指引支撑，App 未修改插件内部即完成实现。唯一实质框架侧缺口是 AI 员工的注册期工具边界：AIEmployeeOptions 无 enabledTools/enabledSkills，运行时外边界 enabledTools 只能在注册后由 upsertEmployee 写入，且未保存选择时默认放行全部 GENERAL 内置工具；Employee Skill 的完成检查「工具列表正好显示所声明的」与 api-reference 对 enabledTools 的「roster 报告」措辞会掩盖这一点。136 条过程错误信号全部为探索性命令非零退出、环境/超时、验证产物缺失或工具约束，未发现由框架导致的运行时失败。

modules.name: AI 员工与工具边界（@nocobase/ai-employee / app-plugin-ai-employee）
modules.scope: App 需注册一个只读资料助手：声明 App 工具、注册员工并保证该员工只能调用这一个只读工具。库侧提供 defineTools/defineAIEmployee/AIEmployeeManager；插件侧在运行时装配员工上下文与候选工具集并以 skillSettings.enabledTools 过滤。本单元评判该库/插件/指引是否把「注册即边界」做成可用能力。
modules.limitations: 未配置可用模型，B01–B05 的实际问答链未能独立复现；本单元结论来自库/插件源码与 App 使用证据，而非端到端 AI 验收。

requirements.need: 注册一个 App 自有工具（defineTools）与一个员工（defineAIEmployee），并让聊天默认打开该员工。
requirements.responsibility: App 负责业务工具与员工定义；框架提供 defineTools/defineAIEmployee 与 AIChatProvider。
requirements.recommendedUsage: defineTools 声明工具，defineAIEmployee 声明员工，AIChatProvider 显式传 username（否则会落到排序最靠前的内置员工）。
requirements.actualUsage: app/server/ai/index.ts 注册 searchMaterials 与 materialsAssistant；materials-assistant.tsx 显式传 ASSISTANT_USERNAME='materials-assistant'。

requirements.need: 把员工可用工具限定为 App 声明的只读工具，避免内置 GENERAL 工具（表单填充、图表、数据查询、网页搜索、子代理等）默认可用。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责注册期工具边界；这是框架库的输入契约问题，不是业务规则。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 指引未给出注册期 allow-list 写法；api-reference 只把 enabledTools 描述为「roster 报告的精确工具」。
requirements.actualUsage: App 先 registerEmployee，再 getEmployee 后调用 upsertEmployee 写入 skillSettings.enabledTools=['search-materials']，并附注释说明 defineAIEmployee 无法表达。

requirements.need: 运行时确实以 enabledTools 作为工具外边界，且选择不能扩权（actor/KB 约束仍生效）。
requirements.recommendedUsage: enabledTools 为外边界（含系统工具）；选择不等于能力授予，仍需 actor 权限与 KB 配置。
requirements.actualUsage: context.js isToolSelected 先按 enabledTools 过滤，再叠加系统工具白名单、webSearch 与 knowledge-base 检查。

requirements.need: 提供可用的聊天界面：安装 registry 扩展并在未配置模型时显示明确状态。
requirements.responsibility: 插件负责扩展与 readiness 数据；App 负责安装与渲染分支。
requirements.recommendedUsage: chat-surfaces.md 的 Install the extension：把 nocobase-ai 安装为 App 源码 client/extensions/nocobase-ai，复用 readiness gate。
requirements.actualUsage: App 安装 client/extensions/nocobase-ai 并在 materials-assistant.tsx 分支处理 loading/error/noEmployee/no models。

requirementFit.reason: App 的只读助手可通过「注册后 upsert」组合达成，但框架没有把注册期边界做实，符合「有明显小缺口」区间。

usability.reason: defineAIEmployee 无法表达 enabledTools，开发者必须自行发现 upsertEmployee 并处理幂等，属明显小障碍。

agentFriendliness.reason: 指引整体详尽，但最关键的工具边界写法缺失，且完成检查措辞与运行时默认不一致。

design.reason: 「声明 vs 管理」分层清晰、运行时外边界设计合理，但注册输入漏掉 enabledTools 形成缺口。

reliability.reason: 运行时过滤有真实实现并叠加 actor/KB 校验；不足在于未保存选择时默认放行全部 GENERAL 工具。

modules.name: 授权模型（@nocobase/authorization / app-plugin-authorization）
modules.scope: 资料必须做记录级读过滤：普通同事只能读非保密行，主管可读全部；写操作只允许改 title/body。App 通过 composite resource、database permission、record access 与 authorizeRepository/withPolicy 组合实现，并在 AI 工具中复用同一策略。
modules.limitations: 未独立运行授权端点；deny/allow 的端到端行为以 QA B00 与源码推理为准，未做自建负例测试。

requirements.need: 记录级读过滤：普通同事不能读到 confidential 行，主管可读全部。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供组合能力，App 声明业务作用域与数据选择。
requirements.recommendedUsage: defineRecordAccess 声明可复用选择（confidential=false），defineDatabasePermission 声明字段，defineCompositeResource 组合业务动作。
requirements.actualUsage: resources.ts/record-access.ts 使用公开 API 声明 view/create/edit/delete 与 materials.public 选择；provider boot 注册。

requirements.need: 路由只暴露授予的动作，且写字段受限（confidential 不可写）。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责路由/授权中间件与字段契约，App 负责暴露面配置。
requirements.recommendedUsage: defineRepositoryApiRoutes 定义暴露面，authz.database.authorizeRepository 将方法绑定到 composite action。
requirements.actualUsage: materials.ts 用 defineRepositoryApiRoutes + 显式 action 策略；resources.ts 只把 title/body 列为写字段。

requirements.need: AI 工具查询复用同一授权策略，不得绕过。
requirements.responsibility: App 负责在工具内调用 authorize；框架提供 withPolicy 与主体解析。
requirements.recommendedUsage: authorize 取 composite view 决策，把 conditions.database[collection] 绑定到 repository.withPolicy。
requirements.actualUsage: search-service.ts 解析 subjects、authorize 后 withPolicy(...).findMany；无策略或 deny 时返回空集合。

requirementFit.reason: 记录级读过滤、字段级写限制与 AI 复用同一策略均可用公开 API 完整表达。

usability.reason: fluent builder + provider boot 注册路径清晰；composite/data-scope/field 概念较多，首次接入成本偏高。

agentFriendliness.reason: SKILL 给出按序实现清单与 enforcement 规则，repository-routes 引用指向明确。

design.reason: 声明（grants）与执行（authorizer/withPolicy）分离，策略在 DB 层而非读取后过滤。

reliability.reason: authorizer 对未知集合/字段直接 deny，且实现代码在冻结包内可核。

modules.limitations: 未运行应用；路由的运行时错误体与浏览器返回行为未独立复现，依赖 QA 与源码。

requirements.need: 为 materials 暴露 typed CRUD 路由，带输入校验与统一错误/响应契约。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供路由工厂与契约；App 负责暴露面配置与业务处理。
requirements.recommendedUsage: defineRepositoryApiRoutes 暴露 POST /api/{name}/{action}；describeRoute/apiValidator/apiErrorResponse 声明契约。
requirements.actualUsage: materials.ts 使用 defineRepositoryApiRoutes + 显式 read/create/update/delete 策略与 action 上限。

requirements.need: ServiceProvider 生命周期与容器 token 绑定。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 继承 ServiceProvider，在 boot 内 resolve 插件 token；createServiceToken 绑定跨模块服务。
requirements.actualUsage: MaterialsProvider/MaterialsAccessProvider 继承 ServiceProvider；tools 用 createServiceToken 共享同一 token。

requirements.need: 新建/编辑/详情做成 URL 可寻址浮层（可直接打开、刷新恢复、返回回到父页）。
requirements.responsibility: 框架/指引提供 overlay 模式，App 负责声明子路由并渲染。
requirements.recommendedUsage: overlay.md：以子路由 + RouteDialog/RouteDrawer 实现，不使用组件内 open 状态。
requirements.actualUsage: client/routes.ts 以 children + new/edit/:materialId/:materialId 嵌套 edit 声明；页面组件包在 RouteDialog 中。

requirementFit.reason: 路由工厂、生命周期与 overlay 模式均可直接满足需求，少量工作为业务处理与字段暴露。

usability.reason: server-routes/overlay 指引完整并带示例；路由契约需要同时掌握 describeRoute/apiValidator/apiError* 等多个入口。

agentFriendliness.reason: 指引明确「无声明即缺陷」并给出可复制样例，降低装配歧义。

design.reason: Router 与 ServiceProvider 职责分离，token 容器按身份绑定，overlay 由路由匹配而非组件状态驱动。

findings.title: defineAIEmployee 无法声明 enabledTools，注册期员工工具边界缺失
findings.detail: AIEmployeeOptions（defineAIEmployee 的输入）只有 skills/tools，没有 enabledTools/enabledSkills；toBuiltInEmployee 生成的 skillSettings 也只含 skills/tools，而 enabledSkills/enabledTools 只在 registerEmployeeInRepository 从已存在行或内部 sourceSettings 参数继承，公开 registerEmployee 不会传该参数。运行时的真正工具外边界是 skillSettings.enabledTools（context.js:277-281）。因此 App 无法在注册声明中表达最小权限，只能 registerEmployee 后 getEmployee 再 upsertEmployee 写入 allow-list。
findings.impact: App 声明的「只读只用一个工具」在注册期并不成立；未保存选择时所有 GENERAL 内置工具（表单填充、图表、数据查询、网页搜索、子代理、MCP）默认对该员工可用，增加误调用与越权风险，并要求业务侧额外写补偿代码。
findings.suggestedChange: 在 AIEmployeeOptions 增加 enabledTools/enabledSkills，并在 registerEmployeeInRepository 首次创建时写入；或在 defineAIEmployee 文档与类型中给出等价的一等公民写法（例如允许 tools 携带 enabled 语义）。

diagnosis.trigger: App 用 defineAIEmployee 声明一个只含 search-materials 的只读员工。
diagnosis.expected: 注册声明即可把该员工的可调用工具限定为声明列表。

processNotes.author: implementer
processNotes.summary: Built the missing materials assistant feature and made the browser-stage acceptance pass end to end. Completed the server model (materials collection, composite authorization resource, seeded permission sets and isolated accounts, read-only search tool and employee), the app-owned page with URL-addressable overlays and gated create/edit/delete, the legacy /api/materials:list and :get aliases the QA probed, and an integration test that boots the real standalone server and asserts the whole access model. In this round fixed the new integration test's 403 (cookie-write CSRF in a bare test server) and a real client bug where a route param id (text) was sent as a Repository filter for an integer column.

blockers.title: unbound-method on destructured seed repository
blockers.symptom: pnpm lint failed: database/main/seeds/202610010002_seed_materials.ts 38:15 error @typescript-eslint/unbound-method — a method not declared with `this: void` may cause unintentional scoping of `this` when separated from its object.
blockers.rootCause: The seed callback destructured `repository` from the SeedContext parameter (`async run({ repository })`). SeedContext.repository is declared as a method, so referencing it detached from its object trips the unbound-method rule.
blockers.resolution: Receive the whole context (`async run(context)`) and call `context.repository('materials')`, keeping the method bound to its object. Runtime behavior is unchanged.

blockers.title: MaterialSeed not assignable to RepositoryRecord
blockers.symptom: tsconfig.server.json typecheck (the stage after lint) reported TS2769 on createOne({ values: material }) — Index signature for type 'string' is missing in type 'MaterialSeed'.
blockers.rootCause: MaterialSeed was declared as an interface, which does not receive an implicit index signature, while Repository.createOne expects values assignable to RepositoryRecord (Record<string, RepositoryMutationScalarValue>).
blockers.resolution: Declared MaterialSeed as an object type alias, which TypeScript treats as compatible with the record index signature. The seed data and behavior are unchanged.

blockers.title: Supervisor findMany answered 403 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN
blockers.symptom: The new materials integration test signed in with a cookie and POSTed /api/materials/findMany; the server answered 403 PERMISSION_DENIED reason INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN. Permission sets and assignments were correct, so the failure looked like an authorization bug.
blockers.rootCause: The authentication plugin rejects a cookie-authenticated write whose Origin is neither the application's own nor a trusted one (auth.js checkCookieWriteOrigin). A bare standalone test server has no configured trusted origin, so a cookie POST is refused before authorization runs. It was never a permission problem.
blockers.resolution: The integration test now signs in with a cookie and then creates an API key for each account and sends it as x-api-key. An API key is not an ambient browser credential, so the CSRF check returns early, and the writes exercise the same path the verifier uses. The browser client sends Origin for POST, so production is unaffected.

blockers.title: Route-param id (text) sent as an integer Repository filter
blockers.symptom: GET /api/materials:get?id=3 answered 400 RepositoryError: Filter value is invalid for Field "id" of type "integer". The client detail drawer and edit dialog built findOne({ filter: { id: materialId } }) from a useParams string, which would have failed the same way at runtime.
blockers.rootCause: Route params and query strings are strings, while the materials id column is an integer and the Repository validates a filter value against the column type. The handler passed the raw string through.
blockers.resolution: Added toMaterialId() in client/pages/materials/types.ts and coerceSelectorValue() in server/materials/read.ts. The client converts the param to a number before the read and treats an unusable param as "not found" without asking the server; the :get route coerces a numeric query string. Material.id is now typed number.

blockers.title: The assistant could have called write-capable built-in tools
blockers.symptom: The requirement is that the assistant only reads materials — it must not create or modify anything, send messages, search the web or delegate to other agents. The AI plugin ships nineteen built-in tools (form filling, charting, data queries, web search, sub-agent orchestration) marked `GENERAL`, so by default every one of them is eligible for a newly registered employee.
blockers.rootCause: The employee was registered with `tools: [{ name: 'search-materials', autoCall: true }]`, but `tools` only adds a specific tool; it does not remove the `GENERAL` set. Eligibility is governed by `skillSettings.enabledTools`, and `defineAIEmployee` has no option for it.
blockers.resolution: After registration the registrar records `skillSettings.enabledTools: ['search-materials']` when the employee has no selection yet, so only the one read-only tool is eligible. A later administrator selection is preserved, the chat window additionally passes `enableWebSearch={false}` and `enableAttachments={false}`, and an integration assertion pins `enabledTools` to `['search-materials']`.

improvements.title: defineAIEmployee cannot express a tool allow-list
improvements.detail: The AI plugin marks every built-in tool it ships (form filling, charting, data queries, web search, sub-agent orchestration) `GENERAL`, which makes all of them eligible for any employee that does not narrow the list. `defineAIEmployee` exposes `tools` (name + autoCall) but no `enabledTools`, and eligibility is read only from the registered employee's `skillSettings.enabledTools`. An application that wants a strictly read-only employee therefore cannot express it at registration time.
improvements.suggestedChange: Let `AIEmployeeOptions` carry `enabledTools`/`enabledSkills` so `toBuiltInEmployee` seeds them on first registration, and document that `tools` alone does not restrict the general tool set.

evidence.excerpt:
## Completion checks

- A first-time visitor lands on the page, sees a usable composer without switching employee or model, sends, and gets a reply. Reload and repeat: this tests a fresh mount, not a warm one.
- Each unhappy configuration shows its own actionable message rather than a composer that looks ready: discovery loading, discovery failed, no accessible employees, model discovery failed, no enabled models.
- The App employee, tool, and skill appear in AI settings after start, and the employee's tool list shows exactly what was declared.
- The new tool runs from chat, is approved when its permission is `ASK`, returns a serializable result, and leaves the expected database row behind. Run it twice and verify no duplicate.
- An unauthorized user is refused by the tool, not only by the prompt.
- The employee the page opens on is the one intended, not whichever sorts first.
- If the chat opens from a floating trigger: clicking the trigger opens the dialog or side panel, and closing it brings the trigger back. A surface that stays shut is holding its own `open` state instead of the controller's; see [chat-surfaces.md § Surfaces](references/chat-surfaces.md#surfaces).

evidence.observation: capabilities.md states the persisted employee record carries enabled/builtIn/deprecated/about/defaultPrompt/skillSettings/knowledgeBase/model settings, which are "administered in AI settings. Do not put them in the definition."
evidence.excerpt:
`skills` and `tools` are the employee's declared capability set, but listing a tool is not always enough to reach it: a tool named by any registered Skill stays behind that Skill until the conversation loads it. Read [How Skills and Tools relate](#how-skills-and-tools-relate) before deciding which of the two lists a capability belongs in — the choice is not cosmetic, and the failure mode is a tool that never activates and never complains.

The persisted employee record carries more than the definition does — `enabled`, `builtIn`, `deprecated`, `about`, `defaultPrompt`, `skillSettings`, `knowledgeBase`, model settings. Those are administered in AI settings. Do not put them in the definition.

evidence.observation: capabilities.md: a tool that registers as GENERAL "reaches every employee whose tool selection has never been saved"; narrowing it for one employee means that employee's tool selection in AI settings or a session skillSettings allowlist.
evidence.excerpt: A server's tools register as `GENERAL` tools named `mcp-<server>-<tool>`, so every employee whose tool selection has never been saved has them from the moment the server connects. Once an employee's tool switches are saved in AI settings, that selection is a fixed list, and a tool discovered afterwards — a new MCP tool included — stays off for that employee until someone switches it on. Use that exact name wherever a tool is named: in a Skill's `tools`, an employee's `tools`, or a session's `skillSettings`. Narrowing them for one employee is its tool selection in AI settings, or a session's `skillSettings` allowlist.

evidence.observation: AIEmployeeOptions (the defineAIEmployee input) declares username/category/description/skills/tools/chatSettings/profile/systemPrompt/sort, but no enabledTools or enabledSkills. AIEmployeeManager exposes registerEmployee and upsertEmployee.

registerEmployeeInRepository builds the stored record from toBuiltInEmployee; enabledSkills/enabledTools are only carried over from an existing row or a sourceSettings argument that the public registerEmployee never passes.
getAIEmployeeTools starts from every GENERAL tool plus getSkill/web search, then merges skillSettings.tools and skillSettings.enabledTools into the candidate set.
isToolSelected makes skillSettings.enabledTools the outer boundary "including system tools"; when no selection is saved the legacy filter admits all GENERAL tools.
App comment records that defineAIEmployee cannot express enabledTools, so restrictToolsToSearch reads the employee and upserts skillSettings.enabledTools = ['search-materials'].
The App chat surface gates on configurationStatus/employees/hasEnabledModels and mounts the chat only once a usable employee and model are observed.

The authorization Skill prescribes the implementation order: defineDatabasePermission, defineCompositeResource, register record access/composites in the provider boot, and bind routes with authorizeRepository or withPolicy.
evidence.excerpt:
## Implement in this order

1. Declare schema and relationships through self-contained migrations. Choose stable composite, page and data scope names. Keep authorization decisions out of migration code.
2. Declare reusable collection permissions with `defineDatabasePermission`; compose user-facing business operations as composite resources with `defineCompositeResource` from `@nocobase/authorization/core`. Explicitly name fields, relation capabilities and every collection a workflow touches.
3. In the owning provider's `boot`, opt collections in with `authz.database.collections.add`, register composites with `authz.compositeResources.define`, record access with `authz.recordAccess.define` and settings items with `authz.settings.add`. Then add a workspace subsection with `authz.ui.sections.add({ name, title, parent })` and list each composite or settings item in it with `authz.ui.place(reference, { section, group? })` (the permission workspace lists sections and subsections on the left and the selected subsection's resources, under optional `authz.ui.groups`, on the right; an unplaced composite or settings item goes under its default section's Other with a startup warning, and a misplaced one fails a development start). Pages are not registered on the server: the client route tree lists them. Release subject registrations at shutdown.
4. Protect every server route with authentication. For a simple single-scope Repository operation, keep `defineRepositoryApiRoutes` and add `authz.database.authorizeRepository` to map methods to composite actions; it reuses or initializes the request's authorization context. For workflows, persisted-state checks, multiple data scopes or custom responses, install `authz.middleware()`, call `c.get('authz').authorize()` once and bind every returned collection policy with `repository.withPolicy()`.
